{"lines":[{"lineId":"5","lineNum":8,"lineType":1,"content":"臣等謹案：六壬大全十二卷，不著撰人名氏。","logicSentenceId":"7679067149928136704","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"6","lineNum":10,"lineType":1,"content":"卷首題懷慶府推官郭載騋校，盖明代所刋","logicSentenceId":"7679067149928153088","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"7","lineNum":12,"lineType":1,"content":"也。","logicSentenceId":"7679067149928153088","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"8","lineNum":12,"lineType":1,"content":"六壬與遁甲、太乙，世謂之三式，而六壬其","logicSentenceId":"7679067149928169472","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"9","lineNum":14,"lineType":1,"content":"傳尤古。","logicSentenceId":"7679067149928169472","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"10","lineNum":14,"lineType":1,"content":"或謂出於黄帝元女，固屬無稽。","logicSentenceId":"7679067149928185856","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"11","lineNum":14,"lineType":1,"content":"要其","logicSentenceId":"7679067149928202240","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"12","lineNum":16,"lineType":1,"content":"為術，固非後世方技家所能造。","logicSentenceId":"7679067149928202240","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"13","lineNum":16,"lineType":1,"content":"大抵數根於","logicSentenceId":"7679067149928218624","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"14","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7376561355748442151"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"15","lineNum":20,"lineType":1,"content":"五行，而五行始於水，舉隂以起陽，故稱壬焉；","logicSentenceId":"7679067149928218624","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"16","lineNum":22,"lineType":1,"content":"舉成以該生，故用六焉。","logicSentenceId":"7679067149928218624","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"17","lineNum":22,"lineType":1,"content":"其有天地盤與神將","logicSentenceId":"7679067149928235008","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"18","lineNum":24,"lineType":1,"content":"加臨，雖漸近竒遁九宫之式，而由干支而有","logicSentenceId":"767906714992 "content":"如今世所傳。","logicSentenceId":"7679068089761136655","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"33","lineNum":44,"lineType":1,"content":"而越絶書載公孫聖亦有今日","logicSentenceId":"7679068089761153039","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"34","lineNum":46,"lineType":1,"content":"壬午，時加南方之語。","logicSentenceId":"7679068089761153039","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"35","lineNum":46,"lineType":1,"content":"其事雖不見經傳，似出","logicSentenceId":"7679068089761169423","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"36","lineNum":48,"lineType":1,"content":"依托。","logicSentenceId":"7679068089761169423","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"37","lineNum":48,"lineType":1,"content":"然趙煜、𡊮康皆後漢人，知其法著於漢","logicSentenceId":"7679068089761185807","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"38","lineNum":50,"lineType":1,"content":"代也。","logicSentenceId":"7679068089761185807","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"39","lineNum":50,"lineType":1,"content":"其書之見於史者，隋志二家，唐志六家，","logicSentenceId":"7679068089761202191","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"40","lineNum":52,"lineType":1,"content":"宋志三十家，而焦竑經籍志所列多至八十","logicSentenceId":"7679068089761202191","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"41","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7376561355748425767"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"42","lineNum":56,"lineType":1,"content":"三家，然多散佚不傳。","logicSentenceId":"7679068089761202191","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"43","lineNum":56,"lineType":1,"content":"其存者如徐道符心鏡、","logicSentenceId":"7679068089761218575","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"44","lineNum":58,"lineType":1,"content":"蔣日新開雲觀月歌、凌福之畢法賦及五變","logicSentenceId":"7679068089761218575","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"45","lineNum":60,"lineType":1,"content":"中黃經，術家奉為蓍蔡。","logicSentenceId":"7679068089761218575","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId {"lines":[{"lineId":"1201","lineNum":1926,"lineType":1,"content":"庚酉辛寅若加臨，寅若加日病來侵。","logicSentenceId":"7679070602758570018","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1202","lineNum":1926,"lineType":1,"content":"卯加三位木就","logicSentenceId":"7679070602758586402","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1203","lineNum":1928,"lineType":1,"content":"金，利遂名成兩稱心。","logicSentenceId":"7679070602758586402","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1204","lineNum":1930,"lineType":2,"content":"庚酉辛乃申酉戌也。寅若臨三位，更乘惡将，為有病來。占寅卯皆木也，寅臨三位為病，何也？荅曰：寅","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1205","lineNum":1932,"lineType":2,"content":"為天之棟梁，臨金為損折之象，故主疾病，為利名不遂也。卯為太冲，臨金有彫斵成𠾖之象也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1206","lineNum":1934,"lineType":1,"content":"寅卯併辰上見魁，戌加三位酒食推。","logicSentenceId":"7679070602758602786","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1207","lineNum":1934,"lineType":1,"content":"舊事有財新事","logicSentenceId":"7679070602758619170","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1208","lineNum":1936,"lineType":1,"content":"悲，虎臨僕逃足病時。","logicSentenceId":"7679070602758619170","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1209","lineNum":1938,"lineType":2,"content":"寅乃青龍之位，卯乃六合之位。辰中有乙木，戌中有辛金。若戌加寅卯辰，則為酒食也。白虎主病，又","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1210","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7376562291434766363"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1211","lineNum":1942,"lineType":2,"content":"為道路。天魁為奴，又為人足。若非僕逃，則主足病也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1400","lineNum":2186,"lineType":2,"content":"太隂：","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1401","lineNum":2186,"lineType":1,"content":"用起隂武何所宜，陰私得助暗扶持。","logicSentenceId":"7679070602909335604","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1402","lineNum":2186,"lineType":1,"content":"常人見處有憂","logicSentenceId":"7679070602909351988","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1403","lineNum":2188,"lineType":1,"content":"疑，君子託人見貴竒。","logicSentenceId":"7679070602909351988","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1411","lineNum":2198,"lineType":2,"content":"天后，為陰人，臨死絶鄉，或母、妻女灾，以應天后受尅。已乗天后，臨亥絶地受尅。未乗天后，臨卯死絶","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1412","lineNum":2200,"lineType":2,"content":"受尅，主陰人災。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1420","lineNum":2208,"lineType":2,"content":"三傳中先㸔尅日者為事神。無尅日，取日尅者為事神。尅者為災，生者為福。曰尅者為財。干尅初，初","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1421","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7376562291434897435"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1422","lineNum":2212,"lineType":2,"content":"尅中，中尅末，利求財極准。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1490","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7376562301589143593"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1491","lineNum":2302,"lineType":2,"content":"年臨處就為所在之方。若不知生死，以行年臨孟為在，仲病季死。不知行年，以天罡加陽孟為安，加","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1492","lineNum":2304,"lineType":2,"content":"陰孟小病，加陽仲不死，加隂仲死。加陽季不死，加隂季死。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"3440","lineNum":2650,"lineType":1,"content":"二貴皆空虚，喜期","logicSentenceId":"7639372696102895631","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3441","lineNum":2650,"lineType":2,"content":"咸象日：山上有澤，咸。君子以虚受人，功無成而終多不見用。　第五十","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3442","lineNum":2652,"lineType":1,"content":"如旦暮貴人皆空亡者，如干投貴人事，已蒙許𠃔，後","logicSentenceId":"7639372696102895631","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3443","lineNum":2654,"lineType":1,"content":"却被人攙越。","logicSentenceId":"7639372696102895631","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3444","lineNum":2654,"lineType":1,"content":"凡占皆不免有此，却終成拙。","logicSentenceId":"7639372696102912015","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3445","lineNum":2654,"lineType":1,"content":"或有人","logicSentenceId":"7639372696102928399","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3446","lineNum":2656,"lineType":1,"content":"報喜，且勿信。","logicSentenceId":"7639372696102928399","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3447","lineNum":2656,"lineType":1,"content":"或同名姓人，後非我喜，誠為虛喜，而","logicSentenceId":"7639372696102944783","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3448","lineNum":2658,"lineType":1,"content":"巳反有所費也。","logicSentenceId":"7639372696102944783","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3449","lineNum":2658,"lineType":1,"content":"俗諺云：爭似不來還不往，亦無懽","logicSentenceId":"7639372696102961167","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3450","lineNum":2660,"lineType":1,"content":"笑亦無憂。","logicSentenceId":"7639372696102961167","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3451","lineNum":2660,"lineType":1,"content":"如丁丑日，","logicSentenceId":"7639372696102977551","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3452","lineNum":2660,"lineType":2,"content":"酉加未","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3453","lineNum":2660,"lineType":1,"content":"作空，","logicSentenceId":"7639372696102977551","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3454","lineNum":2660,"lineType":2,"content":"亥加酉","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3455","lineNum":2660,"lineType":1,"content":"又落空之𩔖。","logicSentenceId":"7639372696102977551","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3456","lineNum":2662,"lineType":1,"content":"主如告貴，先則已𠃔，但事未決，後換旬始有望。","logicSentenceId":"7639372696102993935","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3457","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7376562765454082111"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3458","lineNum":0,"lineType":5,"content":"","figure":{"head":"","descriptions":[],"tplvUrl":"https://p6-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/SK1599/30/ref/1m2m7qgryt8u8/1-SK1599_figure_00009.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-wm-rsize-png:6K-G5YW45Y-k57GN:1200:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=%2BpZ7q%2FvTW1MbJj4SZ5Ef3IakaOI%3D","pictureHeight":302,"pictureWidth":307,"originalUrl":"https://p9-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/SK1599/30/ref/1m2m7qgryt8u8/1-SK1599_figure_00009.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-wm-png:6K-G5YW45Y-k57GN.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=Dw6PaZyOlS%2B2r9VxWNIzmZjnY08%3D","uri":"read/SK1599/30/ref/1m2m7qgryt8u8/1-SK1599_figure_00009.webp"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3459","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7376562765454098495"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3460","lineNum":2670,"lineType":1,"content":"六壬大全卷九","logicSentenceId":"7639372696103010319","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
